question: What was TCS's net margin in FY2025-26?
notes: Formula: net profit / revenue x 100 = 49,210 / 267,021 = 18.43% (same inputs from yfinance and the report). Variants: 49,454 (incl. question: Compare TCS and Wipro debt-to-equity in FY2025-26.
expected_points: TCS has a much lower debt-to-equity than Wipro (about 0.1 vs about 0.2)
TCS 'debt' is only lease liabilities (no borrowings)
Wipro's value depends on the definition: 0.23 with borrowings + leases (yfinance), 0.19 with borrowings only (report)
notes: TCS: yfinance total_debt 11,283 / total_equity 107,240 = 0.105. Report: lease liabilities 9,453 + 1,830 = 11,283 (p166) so yfinance 'debt' = leases; no borrowings; equity attributable 1,07,240; the report's own ratio is printed as 0.1 (p315; debt = borrowings + lease liabilities). Wipro: yfinance 20,291.0 / 88,536.8 = 0.229. Report IFRS (p395, INR million): borrowings 1,962 + 165,912 + leases 26,327 + 8,709 = 202,910 = 20,291 crore (matches yfinance); equity attributable 885,368 = 88,536.8 crore -> 0.229. Wipro's own printed Debt-equity (p45) = 0.19, which reproduces as borrowings only 167,874 / 885,368 = 0.190. Note: Wipro p270 'Debt-equity 0.13' is STANDALONE. Accepted values mix both companies: TCS {0.11, 0.1}, Wipro {0.23, 0.19}.
